mastery: Both forms require 12/12, all 15 objective-ledger rows ready, remediation routes closed, and a closed-note capstone explanation.

remediation.client_flow: Return to L-05-03 and separate endpoint, identity, deployment, request, result, and errors.
remediation.text_speech_pattern: Return to L-05-05 and map input to required output.
remediation.content_understanding: Return to L-05-07 and preserve schema, null, evidence, and provenance.

remediation.readiness_recommendation: Use only allowed cautious states and observed evidence.
